input.explanation: The Loss Run (f001:p1) explicitly prints "2020 - FREIGHTLINER" against VIN 4V4NC9EH9LN248615 for claim GA1092764. However, the VIN decoder confirms this VIN belongs to VOLVO (model year 2020), and the Vehicle Schedule (f014:s1) correctly lists it as a 2020 VOLVO TRACTOR. The make "FREIGHTLINER" is genuinely printed in the loss run document — it is an error in the loss run itself, not a reading/OCR artifact — making the conflict real across the two documents.
